meta.checked_meaning: the parts whose generated modules the Lean kernel accepted at commit (order = F0/Order, tables = F0/Ops, members = F0/Members, families = F0/Families and F0/Named, names = F0/Compound), each theorem pinned at [propext, Quot.sound]; entries of other parts are pending
meta.commit_meaning: commit: the commit whose F0/*.lean facts certify every proved entry of this file (each entry names its theorems); generator_commit: the commit of tools/F0/ExplorerGen.lean that wrote this file
meta.naming: name = the preferred certified family membership (F0.nameOf, F0/Names.lean): families ⊥, ⊤, t, c, g, s, r, w in that order, then the smallest index; t n = rn n [p := ◯⊥] for n ≤ 12, c/g/s/r/w at k = 1…4; a class with no family membership takes a compound name (F0.compoundOf: of the certified x ∘ y or ◯x over family-named operands whose table cell lands in the class, the preferred: a term of a textbook shape (F0.shapeOf) first, then operation order ◯, ∧, ∨, ↠, then the operands in name order), certified by two facts on the family terms (name_bridge); null = neither (unnamed). shape: F0.shapeOf on the name's term, two textbook shapes only; nickname: from the shape only (F0.Shape.nickname); long: the name in words (F0.Fam.word: t rung, c lax rung, g gap, s lax join, r lax arrow, w zigzag). id and legacy (ρk) are the historical labels, kept as stable ids only
